Grimarillion Mastery Codex

65 masteries and 2,197 skills: Grimarillion plus 23 classes from Dawn of Masteries, read from the game database.

Pair Atlas

Values come straight from the game and mod database files (base game, three expansions, then Grimarillion overrides). Ranks above a skill's max can only be reached with +skill bonuses from gear. Flat values that don't change with rank are shown in grey. Damage over time is shown as the total over its duration, as the in-game tooltip does. Flat damage is the skill's base value; your in-game tooltip shows it higher because it adds your character's % bonuses for that damage type.
